defects.cause: Initial Flutter dependency setup changed ignored environment pins. The initial and stable receipts have identical 1422-file input closures but different environment fingerprints; generated plugin line-ending rewrites were incidental.
defects.action: Preserved InputDrift receipt and raw failed assertion; repeated after setup stabilized; missing checkpoint table failed as expected.

defects.cause: Widget fixture disposed a stream while its pending work remained on a paused fake clock.
defects.action: Bounded real-time timeout plus fake-clock pumping preserves full cleanup assertions.

defects.cause: Lazy ListView did not build status text after scrolling to controls; added replay control exposed the same assumption in runtime interruption fixtures.
defects.action: Diagnostic printed visible text; scroll to status before unchanged assertion. Resume also verifies same segment request and exact checkpoint count.

defects.cause: Replay and recovery after a failed drain needed explicit controls; asynchronous controller ticket/state should not be mutable by callers.
defects.action: Added replay without checkpoint mutation, owned cleanup retry, read-only controller state/ticket, post-await availability fences and synchronous ticket retirement before stream cancellation.

defects.cause: Discovery used two nonexistent proposed paths, a Windows wildcard argument, a formatted-test string match and system-default cp874 decoding.
defects.action: Repository-root discovery and exact-path inspection; structural replacement anchors, explicit UTF-8, literal existing paths. No task stop or acceptance bypass.

defects.cause: Current-schema expectations still named schema33/57 tables/47 direct-owner descriptors.
defects.action: Advance current expectations to34/58/48 and explicitly exclude the new table from historical inventories. Preserve all sentinel, transaction, obstruction and integrity assertions.
